content.text: Investigation complete. No restriction on our business exists anywhere; §12.3 affirmatively disclaims one, and the only competition covenant (§12.4) binds the Vendor in our favour.

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement sits at the preferred position: Customer is subject to no non-compete or field-of-use restriction. Section 12.3 expressly confirms that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or conducting business in any field or territory, and records that Customer has given no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment. Searches across the licence/use restrictions (§13), scope (§2), IP (§14), confidentiality (§16), termination and transition (§§9-11), assignment (§24) and General (§30) surfaced no restriction on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, and no post-term covenant of any kind. Section 2.1 reinforces this by disclaiming any minimum quantity or purchase commitment. The only competition covenant runs against the counterparty — §12.4 provides that "Vendor shall not develop or market a service that competes directly with Customer's proprietary analytics products during the term" — which benefits us and is not flagged. The sole restriction binding Customer, §13.4 (no knowing reverse engineering of hosted source code, interference with the Services, bypassing security controls, or unlawful use), is a standard licence-protection provision rather than a non-compete or field-of-use limit on our business, and it is expressly qualified so as not to limit authorized security testing or use of Customer Data and output. No redline is required.
